positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently working on the H1 helicopter training program. Responsible for implementing DI Guy into the simulation, generating training scenarios using DI Guy scenario generator tools. Also responsible for integrating host software with the scenario tool and integrating it with the Visual system (Flight Safety Vital 9) . Responsible for the DIS networking interface between the Life Form Server which hosts the DI Guy software scenarios, and the host computer, as well as interfacing the TEn (Tactical Environment network with both the host computer and the Life Form Server. Responsible for integrating the intefface between the Instructor Operator Station with the Life Form Server to allow selection and control of DI Guy scenarios.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Lead for E-6B program, designed and tested INMARSAT and VHF data-link radios for operation with the Mark III Communication Management Unit airborne router. Modeled ARINC 429 interfaces between the simulated radios and CMU in order to relay ACARS (Aircraft Communication Addressing and Reporting System) data between the aircraft and simulated ground station. Also modeled and integrated the Supplemental Air Cooling System (SACS) functionality into the simulator. 
E-3 NAVWAR Program, modified the existing baseline software to introduce new GPS/INS functionality into the training device, completed preliminary/critical design, hardware/software integration and final customer sell-off of the training device. 
F-18 Canada Program, introduced a Wittenstein control loading system into the training device, modeled all host computer to control loading computer interfaces to ensure proper force feel in roll, pitch, and yaw axes. Also modified the existing auto-throttle function to work with the Wittenstein control loading computer. 
F-18 Miramar Program, modified fuel system software to introduce air to air refueling functionality into the training device.   
Worked on Simuflite C130 program, rehosted visual software from a Perkin Elmer to a Concurrent host computer, and helped upgrade and integrate a new Maxvue Image generator into the trainer. 
Worked on E-6 Rehost  program, Wrote Ada software executive, and rehosted all visual software from Gould to Alpha host  computer. Cleared discrepancy reports for various aircraft disciplines such as avionics, visual and aircraft systems. Took over responsibility of implemented software processes and was responsible for using Clearcase to build software  engineering loads and customer test build releases. 
 C141 Autothrottle modification effort, responsible for defining requirements, identifying data needs, designing testing and performing onsite hardware software integration to meet all customer requirements.

positions.title: Simulation Systems Engineer
positions.description: Worked on MV-22 NAMTs program simulating the  flight control computer software, Designed software to model Maintenance Bit, Control Laws, Actuator Signal Management, and most of the major components of  the Primary Flight Control System.

positions.title: Simulation Analyst
positions.description: Responsibilities included software estimates, interfacing with subject matter experts to verify various aircraft system responses, evaluating peer design reviews, and design and testing for the total Ada Software effort. Designed and tested Ada software for three foreign military sale flight controls trainers. Performed unit level testing of all software, reviewed all hardware requirements, performed hardware software integration testing, and supported all software quality efforts during trainer sell-off.
